description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different transformer model layers when applying various KV cache compression techniques, as described in the paper “More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision Trade-off in KV Cache Compression.” The x-axis represents model layers grouped into ranges: “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29,” indicating a progression through the model’s depth. The y-axis, labeled “Relative Change,” is a linear scale ranging from -15% to +10%, with major tick marks at 5% intervals, showing the percentage deviation from a baseline performance. Four distinct lines are plotted: a red line with square markers labeled “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” starts at approximately +2% at Layer5-12, dips slightly to +1% at Layer13-20, then rises steadily to +8% at Layer29; a yellow line with circle markers labeled “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” (note: label appears duplicated in legend) begins at +2%, increases to +4% at Layer13-20, and climbs to +9% at Layer29; a light blue line with circle markers labeled “RULER4k of 2×tokens,4-bit” starts at 0%, drops to -2% at Layer13-20, then surges to +7% at Layer29; and a dark blue line with square markers labeled “RULER4k of 1×tokens,4-bit” begins at -2%, plunges to -15% at Layer13-20, then recovers sharply to +6% at Layer29. A gray dashed line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” remains flat at 0% across all layers, serving as the reference point for relative changes.
